Title: MemorySmith.Agent — Entity Observation System: PhysicsTick Scanning & Hostile Mob Detection
Content:
## Overview

The entity observation system provides passive, periodic scanning of entities near the bot. It runs on every `physicsTick` via Mineflayer, with a cooldown to avoid excessive CPU usage. The observed entities feed into the dashboard display, threat detection, and the observe→evaluate replan loop.

## JS Adapter (`MineflayerAdapter/index.js`) — Sprint 55 Wave B

### Entity Scanning

| Property | Value |
|----------|-------|
| Trigger | `bot.on('physicsTick', scanNearbyEntities)` |
| Cooldown | `C.ENTITY_SCAN_COOLDOWN_MS` = 3000ms (3 seconds) |
| Radius | `C.ENTITY_SCAN_RADIUS` = 32 blocks |
| Entity types | `mob` and `object` (items on ground) |

### Scan Logic

```js
function scanNearbyEntities() {
    const now = Date.now();
    if (now - _lastEntityScanAt < C.ENTITY_SCAN_COOLDOWN_MS) return;
    _lastEntityScanAt = now;

    for (const e of Object.values(bot.entities ?? {})) {
        if (!e || !e.position) continue;
        if (e.type !== 'mob' && e.type !== 'object') continue;
        const dist = Math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy + dz*dz);
        if (dist > C.ENTITY_SCAN_RADIUS) continue;
        observed.push({
            name, type, hostile: HOSTILE_MOB_NAMES.has(rawName),
            x, y, z, distance, health?
        });
    }
    if (observed.length > 0) {
        observed.sort((a, b) => a.distance - b.distance);
        sendEvent('entityObserved', { entities: observed, botPos, timestamp });
    }
}
```

### Hostile Mob Names (28 types)

```javascript
const HOSTILE_MOB_NAMES = new Set([
  'zombie', 'skeleton', 'creeper', 'spider', 'cave_spider',
  'witch', 'enderman', 'blaze', 'ghast', 'magma_cube', 'slime',
  'wither_skeleton', 'stray', 'husk', 'drowned', 'phantom',
  'pillager', 'vindicator', 'evoker', 'ravager', 'hoglin',
  'piglin', 'piglin_brute', 'zombified_piglin', 'guardian',
  'elder_guardian', 'silverfish', 'endermite', 'vex',
  'warden', 'breeze', 'bogged',
]);
```

Note: `itemType` objects (e.g., dropped items) are never marked as hostile.

### Block Observation

| Property | Value |
|----------|-------|
| Trigger | `bot.on('physicsTick', scanBlockBelow)` |
| Cooldown | 1000ms (1 second) |

Emits `blockBelowChanged` event when the block beneath the bot changes.

## C# Events (`Agent.Core/Events/WorldEvents.cs`) — Sprint 55 Wave C

### EntityObservedEvent

```csharp
public sealed record EntityObservedEvent(
    IReadOnlyList<ObservedEntity> Entities,
    Position BotPosition,
    DateTimeOffset Timestamp) : WorldEvent(Timestamp);
```

Emitted periodically (cooldown ~3s) when mobs are within `ENTITY_SCAN_RADIUS` blocks.

### ObservedEntity

```csharp
public sealed record ObservedEntity(
    string Name,
    string Type,       // "mob", "object", "player"
    bool Hostile,
    int X, int Y, int Z,
    double Distance,
    int? Health = null,
    string? Username = null);
```

### BlockBelowChangedEvent

```csharp
public sealed record BlockBelowChangedEvent(
    string Name,
    int Type,
    int X, int Y, int Z,
    DateTimeOffset Timestamp) : WorldEvent(Timestamp);
```

## WebSocket Bridge Parsing

`WebSocketBridge.cs` contains `ParseEntityObserved(JsonElement root, DateTimeOffset now)` which parses the `entityObserved` wire event into the typed C# event.

## Dashboard Integration

Observed entities are pushed to the dashboard via `DashboardPublisherImpl.SetNearbyEntities()` and serialized as `ObservedEntityDto` in the `AgentStatusUpdate` SignalR payload.
